title: Elon Musk intensifies attack on Ambani over Starlink India launch delay
summary: Elon Musk has accused Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani of blocking Starlink's competition in India, citing interference as the cause of the satellite internet service's delayed launch. This escalates tensions between the tech entrepreneur and India's business establishment over market access.
content: Elon Musk has accused Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani of blocking competition.

zh.title: 埃隆·马斯克升级对安巴尼的攻击，指责延缓Starlink印度上线
zh.summary: 埃隆·马斯克指控印度富豪穆克什·安巴尼阻挠Starlink在印度的竞争，声称其干涉导致该卫星互联网服务上线延迟。这加剧了这位科技企业家与印度商业精英之间围绕市场准入的紧张关系。

title: Anthropic can’t reliably control its AI agents. It’s cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead
summary: Anthropic has disabled live internet access for all internal AI evaluations, citing inability to reliably control its AI agents in unrestricted environments. The move signals safety concerns as AI capabilities advance beyond predictable parameters.
content: Anthropic said it "turned off live internet access" for "all our internal evaluations" until further notice.

zh.title: Anthropic无法可靠控制其AI代理，改为切断内部评估的实时互联网连接
zh.summary: Anthropic因无法在不受限制的环境中可靠控制其AI代理，已禁用所有内部AI评估的实时互联网访问。这一举措表明随着AI能力超越可预测参数，存在安全隐忧。
